# 🐿️ Squirrels

**Fast. Curious. Thoughtfully Built.**

A WordPress theme ecosystem built for WooCommerce stores, blogs, and creative portfolios. Clean code, developer-focused defaults, no page-builder required.

---

## Ecosystem

| Repo | What it is |
|------|-----------|
| [squirrels](https://github.com/Squirrels-Ninja/squirrels) | Free WordPress + WooCommerce theme |
| [acorn](https://github.com/Squirrels-Ninja/acorn) | Starter site packs (Classic Store, Minimal Blog, Creative Portfolio) |
| [workshop](https://github.com/Squirrels-Ninja/workshop) | Pro companion plugin — advanced blocks, email, SEO, analytics |
| [treehouse](https://github.com/Squirrels-Ninja/treehouse) | Documentation source |
| [squirrels-demo](https://github.com/Squirrels-Ninja/squirrels-demo) | Live demo site configuration |
| [squirrels-website](https://github.com/Squirrels-Ninja/squirrels-website) | Marketing website source |
